rows.title: Freeze post-v24 as a profile-only completion lane
rows.acceptance: All pack docs treat v24 as the terminal general-purpose horizon and reject speculative v25 inflation.
rows.required_proof: Root docs + no-v25 rationale + exec plan.

rows.title: Freeze the profile-family registry, owners, and filenames
rows.acceptance: Every profile family has one owner, one schema, one example, and one manifest entry.

rows.title: Add shared ID plan for all profile-layer artifacts
rows.acceptance: `stack-ids` additions are enumerated once and reused everywhere.

rows.title: Land privacy / retention / redaction profile families
rows.acceptance: P1 families exist as named schemas, examples, fixtures, and conformance notes.

rows.title: Prove audit export remains redacted, budgeted, and evidence-preserving
rows.acceptance: Audit extraction is impossible without a typed policy and redaction set.

rows.title: Land locality / tenancy / residency overlay families
rows.acceptance: P2 families exist and bind transfer classes to typed exception paths.

rows.title: Prove cross-boundary transfer block and bounded exception path
rows.acceptance: Boundary exceptions expire and remain reviewable.

rows.title: Land role catalog, delegation matrix, approval matrix, and conflict catalog
rows.acceptance: P3 families exist as canonical profile surfaces.

rows.title: Prove recusal and dual-control semantics stay explicit
rows.acceptance: Conflicts cannot be resolved through hidden override.

rows.title: Land regulated deployment mapping and recertification families
rows.acceptance: P4 families exist and bind regime requirements to canonical evidence families.

rows.title: Prove overdue recertification blocks promotion readiness
rows.acceptance: Expired certification schedules surface as typed blocked state.

rows.title: Land hazard libraries, scenario catalog, monitors, and mitigation playbooks
rows.acceptance: P5 families exist and point into release and incident surfaces.

rows.title: Prove playbook activation links hazard semantics to containment/recovery
rows.acceptance: Hazard doctrine is operationally meaningful, not decorative.

rows.title: Land vendor certification adapter families
rows.acceptance: P6 families exist and translate vendor artifacts into typed internal targets.

rows.title: Prove revocation and downgrade are typed on vendor failure
rows.acceptance: Vendor artifacts never silently remain trusted after revocation.

rows.title: Land incident taxonomy, severity matrix, pager route, and escalation clock families
rows.acceptance: P7 families exist as canonical incident-profile surfaces.

rows.title: Prove timeout-driven escalation remains typed and replayable
rows.acceptance: Pager escalation cannot live only in external service configuration.

rows.title: Wire profile registries into existing owner crates and schema publisher
rows.acceptance: The exact file-touch map covers every existing owner and no new workspace crates are introduced.

rows.title: Freeze post-v24 release bar and documentation-truth rule
rows.acceptance: The repo teaches the profile layer as profile layer, not as a hidden v25.

rows.title: Validate pack completeness and manifest truth
rows.acceptance: Required docs exist; counts match; manifests and fixtures agree.
